records.meaning: Native immutable accounting truth for one legal entity and reporting basis.
Normalized authoritative operational evidence requesting an accounting consequence for one legal entity.
Effective-dated executable entity policy that maps AccountingEvent evidence to a journal draft; identified semantically and by exact executable identity.
Place of business/branch scope of a legal entity; not automatically a separate legal entity.
Statutory tax relationship of a legal entity with an authority/jurisdiction; independent of domicile and establishment.
Effective-dated exact configuration of the ruleset/rounding/granularity/return scheme under one TaxRegistration.
Evidence-bound output of the exact selected jurisdiction tax policy; it does not choose GL accounts.
Effective-dated jurisdiction/currency/tender rounding configuration applied to an already-accounted settlement amount.
Independent professional/regulatory relationship; not a synonym for tax registration.
Scoped client/trust-money arrangement linked to establishment/regulator/currency without embedding substantive regulator rules.
Immutable selection definition over one or more books and exact dimensions.
Sealed evidence of the exact accounting population selected by a ReportingBoundary at a source-book cutoff.
Evidence binding an exact snapshot to an attestor, asserted authority and proof/key identities.
Evidence of which exact snapshot and attestation set was submitted and what external receipt/status identity was returned.
Immutable ORIGINAL/AMENDMENT/CORRECTION report version, with exact predecessor lineage when applicable.
Separate store of external financial-statement evidence used for analysis/reconciliation; not native GL truth.
Cross-event economic linkage for reconciliation; not authority.
Immutable identity of the exact executable policy/artifact used, distinct from semantic policyRef.
